 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Robin Phukan
 Order

18.09.2023 Heard Mr. S. Borthakur, learned counsel for the petitioner and also heard Ms. N. Das,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam, appearing for the State respondent No.1.

In this petition, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the petitioner, namely,
Jonathon Terang has prayed for quashing the FIR of Diphu P.S. Case Page No.# 2/2 No.70/2023 under Section 498A/323 IPC and the Charge-sheet No.55/2023, dated 31.07.2023, in the aforementioned FIR and the PRC Case No.113/2023 pending before the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Karbi Anglong, Diphu, against the present petitioner and the order dated 17.08.2023, passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Karbi Anglong, Diphu.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Karbi Anglong, Diphu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is to be noted here that vide impugned order dated 17.08.2023, the learned Court below has taken cognizance against the petitioner for the offence under Section 498A/323 IPC.

It is also to be Jonathon Terang vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129715990/
1 mentioned here that the aforementioned case has been registered on the basis of one FIR lodged by one Romir Lekthepi on 01.07.2023.

sentences.text: Perused the petition and the documents placed on record.
Let notice be issued, returnable in 4(four) weeks.
Steps be taken upon the respondent No.2 by registered post with A/D and also by usual process within a week from today.
No formal notice is required to be issued to respondent No.1 since Ms. N. Das, learned Additional P.P. has entered appearance and received notice.
However, extra requisite copy of the petition be furnished to Ms. Das during the course of the day.

Considering the submission of learned counsel for the petitioner and also considering the facts and circumstances of the record, further proceeding of PRC Case No.113/2023 pending before the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Karbi Anglong, Diphu, stands stayed, till the returnable date.
